changelog:
Initial release — provides a specialized workflow helper for self-improving, proactive agent-style work productivity needs.

- Supports AI agent users, skill authors, and teams with validated demand for improved, reliable, and practical workflow artifacts.
- Delivers work plans, checklists, implementation support, and tailored artifacts for fixing bugs, hardening setups, and creating adjacent skills.
- Focuses on practical, local-hardware-friendly outputs such as templates, scripts, and analysis over large cloud-based solutions.
- Includes validation and verification steps so users can easily act on results.
- Triggered by keywords related to work productivity, self-improvement, and proactive agent workflows.
